claims.evidence: Witness photos show orange LPG cylinders but do not show the cylinder size/capacity (kg) or any readable markings confirming 12.5kg.
Photos show visible dents/scratches/scuffs and wear, but do not provide performance or reliability proof.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak
claims.evidence: No leak test results, certification papers, inspection tags, or expiry/compliance markings are shown.
Photos show a valve/regulator connection on top, but the valve’s age/newness and condition of threads are not clearly verifiable.

risks.risk: Cylinder capacity (kg) may not be 12.5kg; wrong size affects value and usability.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped/printed capacity (kg) and model/grade markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown-size foreign-used cylinder set with possible mismatch in capacity.

risks.risk: Fill level may be empty or low; buyer may pay for cylinders without usable gas.
risks.proof: A photo showing the cylinder’s current fill indicator/level (if present) or a receipt/verification of recent filling.
risks.if_unproven: Price as empty/unknown fill (worst case for immediate use).

risks.risk: Leak risk and safety condition (valve/regulator/threads/hose) not proven by photos.
risks.proof: A video of a proper leak test (soap-bubble test) around valve/regulator connections and a pressure/hold test if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven leak-free; treat as requiring inspection/testing before use.

risks.risk: Valve/regulator may be missing, incompatible, or not functional even if present.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the regulator/hose connection, including the regulator brand/model and the hose condition; plus a short clip showing it assembled and secured.
risks.if_unproven: Price as regulator/hose condition unknown and potentially needing replacement.

risks.risk: Physical damage (dents/scuffs) could indicate compromised integrity or higher risk.
risks.proof: Multiple close-up angles of dents (including any deep dents) and the base/bottom ring area; ideally a professional inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case used condition based on visible wear/dents.

risks.risk: Number of cylinders included may be more/less than shown (photos show at least two).
risks.proof: A wide shot showing the full quantity being sold laid out clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the minimum confirmed quantity shown (at least two), with uncertainty on extras.

risks.risk: Accessories/certification tags/inspection markings may be missing or expired.
risks.proof: Clear photos of any certification/inspection stamps, compliance tags, and expiry/inspection dates on the cylinder body.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the cylinder capacity (kg) and any stamped/printed model/grade markings.
Photos showing the valve/regulator area with threads clearly visible (both cylinders).
Video of a soap-bubble leak test around valve/regulator connections (and any hose connection if included).
Photo/video showing whether regulator and hose are included, with brand/model and condition.
Wide shot confirming the exact number of cylinders included in the sale.
Photos of any inspection/certification/compliance tags or stamps and their dates.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item type (orange LPG cylinders) and visible wear, but key pricing drivers—capacity (kg), leak-free/testing proof, and valve/regulator functionality—are not shown clearly. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
